title: RossFast surgical Richards-solver substitution

reconcile.finding: The canonical Reference path already constructs soil_water_solve_request_t and has exactly one polymorphic soil_water_solver_t solve seam in fmr_serialized_advance. F-ROSS11 whole-model application composition is therefore too high-level for production solver substitution.

bounded_scope.goal: Use the existing soil_water_solver_t seam so Reference and RossFast share SWAP state, forcing, transaction and commit lifecycle; only the concrete Richards solution method changes.

implementation_plan: Add a thin RossFast adapter implementing soil_water_solver_t around the unchanged rossfast_d3r_table_kernel_t.
Translate the existing soil_water_solve_request_t state and prescribed fluxes to the qualified RossFast kernel request and translate its candidate back to soil_water_solve_result_t.
Bind model choice at the existing fmr_serialized_advance solver call, preserving Reference code path byte-for-byte where practical.
Fail closed before physical mutation when selected RossFast configuration lies outside the admitted envelope.
Qualify O0 and O2 with Reference bypass, RossFast delegation, rejection/no-mutation and real table-kernel execution.
next_permitted_action: Implement and compile-qualify the thin soil_water_solver_t RossFast adapter first. Do not wire application selection into the Reference backend until the adapter itself is green.
explicit_exclusions: F-ROSS11 whole-model runtime as production execution host
root or general source-sink RossFast support
